reconciliation.justification: Birthday ritual not in scope. Left where it fell.

corrections.notes: A mediocre-practitioner correction: sees Tomas -> Halloway West -> Employment -> Remove. Satisfies the immediate requirement (removing the employment record and its direct dependents). Does not perceive what the ritual meant to the building. Correct by every measurable criterion — this is exactly how correction debt begins.

The Choir corrected the visible anomaly (chairs throwing themselves toward exits) by resolving the underlying labor-procedural contradiction. Eleven weeks later, the same 'leave/exit/return/refusal/departure' semantic structure manifested at Western Tolerance Hall, which had no local labor dispute of its own — the first confirmed Bloomrot manifestation in this world's current record.
